modules.name: Accessibility and Language
modules.description: UI/UX standards for accessibility and language support across the Customer Support App screens.

requirements.title: Text contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA
requirements.description: Text contrast on the app screens must meet WCAG 2.1 AA.

requirements.title: Support phone's large-text setting
requirements.description: The app supports the phone's large-text setting without breaking the layout.

requirements.title: Support English, Gujarati and Hindi
requirements.description: The app supports English, Gujarati and Hindi, with every screen fully in one language.

requirements.title: Icons carry text labels
requirements.description: Icons always carry a text label.

rules.title: No mixed languages on a screen
rules.description: Every screen must be fully in one language (English, Gujarati or Hindi), never mixed.
